seo.description: See the latest features, improvements, new content, and fixes for TestingWithEkki.

title: Changelog
subtitle: Stay up to date with the latest features and improvements

entries.title: Release Readiness
entries.description: Hardened capstone and evidence-based grading, improved practice error recovery, added guarded curriculum migration tooling, and expanded cross-locale end-to-end coverage for a safer release.

entries.title: Web Automation Curriculum
entries.description: Refreshed the Web Automation curriculum across nine modules with clearer bilingual lessons, visual learning aids, runnable examples, and practice challenges aligned to each learning outcome.

entries.title: Learn and Practice
entries.description: Introduced unified Learn and Practice catalogs with guided module discovery, search and filters, progress tracking, completion rewards, preview mode, and a more focused in-browser practice workspace.

entries.title: Rebrand v1
entries.description: Launched a refreshed TestingWithEkki experience with a new visual system, QA illustrations, improved homepage and public surfaces, a community-focused leaderboard, Labs, and updated account and profile flows.

entries.title: Platform Launch
entries.description: Welcome to TestingWithEkki! We're excited to launch the platform with comprehensive Playwright tutorials, interactive coding challenges, and a global leaderboard. Start your journey to becoming a test automation expert today.
